title: Sell Mineral Rights in Rosebud, MT
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Rosebud, MT
metaDescription: Rosebud, MT sits in the Colstrip coal economy, east of the Northern Cheyenne Reservation. I buy coal, CBM, and oil and gas mineral interests here directly.
heroLead: The community of Rosebud sits east of reservation land, in the part of the county whose economy runs on coal, not on trust status.
intro: Unlike Lame Deer to the west, mineral interests near the community of Rosebud are generally fee land, held privately and transferred through the county recorder rather than through BIA approval. What shapes the record out here instead is the Rosebud Mine and the Colstrip power plant it feeds — decades of coal-specific mineral severances, sometimes split off from oil and gas rights under the same ground, sometimes not. I read the actual deed language before assuming which rights your family holds.

That mine has been operating for decades, and its footprint touches a lot of surrounding ranchland, which means a fair number of families out here hold mineral interests connected to it without ever having worked for the operation themselves.

sections.heading: Coal-specific severances near the mine
paragraphs: A mineral deed reserving "coal" from a decades-old conveyance doesn't automatically include oil and gas rights, and the reverse is also true. I check the specific language on your family's deed rather than assuming a full-mineral package. It's a common enough split in this part of Rosebud County that I never take it for granted.

sections.heading: Coalbed methane on the edge of the Powder River trend
paragraphs: This part of the county also touches the Powder River Basin's CBM trend, though less densely developed than further south. I check whether your parcel carries any current or expired CBM lease before discussing value.

sections.heading: What I verify before making an offer
paragraphs: I pull the recorded chain from the Rosebud County Clerk and Recorder in Forsyth, confirm which mineral rights your family's deed actually covers, and check current lease and production status. That groundwork determines the offer, not a guess based on the community's coal reputation.

faqs.question: Does my family own coal rights or oil and gas rights near Rosebud?
faqs.answer: It depends on the deed language from the original severance. I read it directly to confirm rather than assuming.

faqs.question: Is there coalbed methane activity near Rosebud?
faqs.answer: Some, tied to the county's edge of the broader Powder River Basin trend, though less dense than areas further south. I check your specific parcel.

faqs.question: Is this fee land or trust land?
faqs.answer: Generally fee land east of the reservation boundary, though I confirm the specific status for your parcel before quoting.

faqs.question: Does the Rosebud Mine's activity affect my mineral value directly?
faqs.answer: Only if your specific interest is tied to the leased or permitted coal ground. I check that connection rather than assuming proximity alone counts.
